reviews.title: If you don’t want to talk to anyone talk to you.
reviews.text: I’ve been in therapy for several years and nothing has really stuck, but seeing how talking to myself and talking things out and feeling like I can be unconditionally honest without judgment has been extremely helpful. I also feel like it’s a great way to use a video of yourself and write at the same time because I remember more what I write than what I say. Love the app if you don’t feel like talking to someone talk to yourself.

reviews.title: I love it - but some suggestions to enhance to user experience
reviews.text: I love this app. I love the editing capability. I love the presets. I love PINK! If I was I was sat down and asked how to elevate this platform I’d give a couple of suggestions: allowing edits to the texts or layers after you have hit a check mark - it’s really frustrating to start all over when something doesn’t look right. Not reverting back to original photo when you move things around the photo - it’s hard to center things or know the colors fit or something is out of place when you are kind of blindly moving things around it would be nice to just keep things dragable and within our sight. Final critique and not even a big one is helping identify where the center of a picture is - kind of like instagram stories have they allow you to see if you placed something here it’s dead center vs here is more of a header.

reviews.title: Stop giving me tutorials every single time I use the app

However it makes me insane that every single time I open the app it shows me a tutorial. I know how to use it. I’m not going to upgrade my already paid membership. I don’t think I’ve ever left an App Store review before but this makes me so nutty I couldn’t stand it anymore.
